method: Lines and pairs come from each team's latest game: forwards grouped by who shared the most ice with whom (the NHL's shift charts), defensemen in twos, ordered by ice time; goalies by starts in the last 10 games, their usage the share of those starts. A rostered player who did not dress is a scratch; injuries from ESPN's report. Ice time is projected as a decayed average of this season pulled toward last season's; goals, assists and shots are his per-60 rates (this season pulled toward last season's, and that toward his position's) times the projected ice time. Pace is the team's shots per game. These are projections, not picks. Backtest on 2025-26 games from 1/15/2026, tuned on the games before it, each game projected only from the games before it: Ice time (minutes), average miss 1.87 vs 2.03 season average and 1.97 last 3 (better than both; by squared error 2.48 vs 2.62, better, 20,487 games); Goals, average miss 0.273 vs 0.27 season average and 0.273 last 3 (worse than the season average; by squared error 0.419 vs 0.422, better, 20,487 games); Assists, average miss 0.406 vs 0.399 season average and 0.403 last 3 (worse than the season average; by squared error 0.537 vs 0.54, better, 20,487 games); Points, average miss 0.535 vs 0.525 season average and 0.551 last 3 (worse than the season average; by squared error 0.684 vs 0.687, level, 20,487 games); Shots on goal, average miss 1.016 vs 1.017 season average and 1.133 last 3 (level with the better one; by squared error 1.305 vs 1.311, level, 20,487 games). This season to date (3,838 skater-games): ice time misses by 1.89 minutes vs 1.94 for the season average, points by 0.538 vs 0.544. Goals, assists and points barely beat the season average at best, so read them as a player's usual rate, not an edge.

backtest.window: 2025-26 games from 1/15/2026, tuned on the games before it
